title: fabric-interop: at a node that queues, the JSON of the text content of a queue-full refusal at a job's start and of unknown-job (DEC-0104)
description: An isError tool result with no structuredContent (a client validates structuredContent against the job tool's outputSchema even on an error) and one text content item whose text is this JSON: a refusal that started nothing and stored nothing, at a node that queues (one that declares the load extension): queue-full at a job's start (with its data), or unknown-job for an id the callee never issued or another caller's job. Only these two; a provider that does not queue keeps C3.2's unknown-job rule, and every provider's other refusals keep their own shapes. The error is interop-common's, so queue-full's data is bound here.
